payload.action: Review Loop iteration 5 finding detected: FIND-R3-005-01
symptoms: The host worktree is bind-mounted without --user host uid:gid, so on a Linux host whose uid is not 1000 the container cannot write the worktree or leaves uid-1000 files in the host .git; the integration test masks this by passing --user itself.
